# Puraniks Abitante Fiore Bavdhan - Official AI Knowledge Base

> Single verified source of truth for Puraniks Abitante Fiore residential township in Bavdhan Budruk, Pune, developed by Puranik Builders Ltd.

## Project Summary
- Project Name: Puraniks Abitante Fiore
- Developer: Puranik Builders Ltd. (Founded 1990, 34+ years legacy, 46+ delivered landmark projects)
- Location: Bavdhan Budruk, Near Crystal Honda Service Station, Off Mumbai-Bangalore Highway (NH 48), Pune - 411021, Maharashtra, India
- Township Size: 45-Acre Integrated Hilltop Township
- Concept: Italian Riviera Themed Oxygen-Rich Homes with Balcony Gardens
- Configurations: 1 BHK, 2 BHK Smart, 2 BHK Luxury, 2.5 BHK, 3 BHK Imperial Residences
- Starting Price: ₹51.99 Lakhs* (1 BHK), ₹63.99 Lakhs* (2 BHK Smart), ₹78.50 Lakhs* (2 BHK Luxury), ₹97.50 Lakhs* (3 BHK Imperial)
- Official Sales Contact: +91 80689 76983

## Official MahaRERA Registrations

- Phase 2B: P52100020238 (Finishing Stages)
- Phase 2C: P52100048353 (Under Construction)
- Phase 2C1: P52100049352 (New Launch Oxygen Wings)
- Environmental Clearance: Certified by MoEF & CC (Formally registered as Puraniks Abitante Phase II)
